scripts.build: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm --filter @starter/server run build && pnpm --filter @starter/client run build
scripts.build:server: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/server run build
scripts.build:client: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/client run build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:client && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @starter/server run test && pnpm run test:electron && pnpm run test:desktop:release
scripts.contract:emit: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/server exec tsx src/contract/emit-trpc-contract.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm -r --filter '!@starter/shared' run typecheck && pnpm typecheck:electron
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n next,electron -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @starter/client dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && pnpm electron:compile && ELECTRON_DEV_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron electron/dist/main.js"
scripts.cap:overlay: node scripts/cap-add.mjs ios --overlay-only && node scripts/cap-add.mjs android --overlay-only
scripts.cap:run:ios: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs ios && cap run ios --no-sync
scripts.cap:run:android: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs android && cap run android --no-sync
scripts.build:ios:release: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs ios && cap open ios
scripts.build:android:release: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:android:apk: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
